consolidated_results.work_mode: On-site (based in Polanco; regional travel required)
consolidated_results.jd: Based in Polanco, Mexico City. Elevate customer experience and support business performance across LATAM Visual Merchandising. Create impactful visual displays, ensure consistency with global standards, collaborate with Store Planning/Merchandising and Store Managers, execute seasonal guidelines/campaigns, support new store openings/renovations, monitor quality, travel across LATAM as needed. Requires solid experience in retail visual merchandising for premium/luxury brands, creativity, commercial sensibility, attention to detail, hands-on approach.
